mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies with a temperature of 73 degrees, feeling like 78, near the Verona Area High School, under a Waning Gibbous moon.

The city has officially unveiled the Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture at Century School Park, carved from a reclaimed ash tree by artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland to celebrate the art of movement.

We have a busy day in Verona with the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, yoga at Insight Wellness, live music at Paddy Mac's, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory all taking place today, plus Hop Haus Trivia coming up tomorrow.
On August 30, officers responded to a report of a smashed vehicle window on North Edge Trail where they identified a suspect and entered an arrest warrant into the system.
Treat yourself to today's flavor, Oreo Reese's Cheesecake, when the restaurant opens its doors today at 10:00 AM.
